title: ranunculus grandilobatus
intro: Ranunculus grandilobatus, commonly known as the small-flowered buttercup, is a perennial plant belonging to the Ranunculaceae family. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which have been reported to exhibit therapeutic actions such as analgesia, antispasmodic, and antiviral activities. The health benefits of R. grandilobatus may include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of respiratory and gastrointestinal disorders.
